definition: Karen Livescu is an American computer scientist specializing in speech processing and natural language processing, and applications of deep learning to these topics.
details: She is a professor in the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago and a part-time associate professor of computer science at the University of Chicago.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Karen Livescu.
